answer: To secure autonomous agents against Sybil attacks, we route ephemeral identity proofs through a cryptographic inlet where recursive zero-knowledge STARK commitments bind verifiable reputation to hardware-bound entropy. By injecting verifiable random function sortition and sequential delay primitives like an immutable plume of sequential computations, we force identity cloning to require infeasible parallel brute-force cycles. This constructs an ivory fortress of cryptographic finality, ensuring Byzantine fault tolerance natively rejects unbonded replicas.
